SE-017.test: SE-017-npc-scene: a naturally moving real NPC enters another scene with one canonical location
SE-017.evidence: An original n93 actor naturally walks outside then enters b-cafe in one unmodified seeded world. Player stays unchanged. Stable NPC identity, one normalized person/location authority, materialization and real codec reload are asserted.

SE-028.test: SE-028-reputation-effects: earned reputation changes actual faction eligibility and survives save reload
SE-028.evidence: Two actual HELP conversations consume inventory and earn reputation0→3→6. Admission is rejected below5 after reload and accepted above5 after reload; real faction membership, joinedAt/change clock and influence persist through another save/reload.

SE-021.test: SE-021-job-schedule: replacement employment owns the actual future shift clock and pay without stale prior bookings
SE-021.evidence: Replacement employment owns a new actual shift commitment with its employer,wage and future endsAt. Real simulation time proves no early payment, one correct new-employer payment at the deadline, preserved booking after reload and rejection of stale former start commands.
SE-021.scope: Active shift deadline model only. All job durations remain the actual60minutes. The game has no recurring employment calendar or future reservation planner; this test does not claim either feature.
